args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, COUNT(DISTINCT rider_id) AS riders, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months, ROUND(AVG(duration_min),1) AS avg_min, ROUND(COUNT(*)*SINGLE + SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' AND duration_min>S THEN duration_min-S ELSE 0 END)*OVER + SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='electric_bike' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)*EBIKE, 2) AS pay_per_use_total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' AND duration_min>M THEN duration_min-M ELSE 0 END)*MEMBER_OVER + SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='electric_bike' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)*MEMBER_EBIKE, 2) AS member_residual_charges FROM trips
